acceptance_tests: X1: for every top-level field of the two canonical SCC schemas record identical / one-way / incomparable with exact json paths
X2: flag every place C0 semantics enter the C2 schema or vice versa OUTSIDE anti_scope/variants
X3: verify the one-way ledger C0-inextendibility => C2-inextendibility (extension-class containment); flag any statement of the converse
X4: verify the composite-regularity ban; no merged regularity class outside an explicit forbidden-phrase quotation
X5: report must say it audits separation, not truth, and claims no node complete
do_not_claim: No node completion, no theorem, no physics result. Report unverified; the schema owner (lead-formulation) binds interpretation. Write only under your own artifacts/<worker>/ path.
falsifier: If a placement exists in which the C2 schema's conclusion is satisfied by a C0-only extension class (or vice versa), separation fails; report exact path and repair.
revision_requirements: Your proposed deliverable schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml is superseded: canonical C2 file is artifacts/formulation/schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml. Do not author schemas.
stop_rule: 3.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.
